q: 1. The presence of more than ........ % of members in Nepal engineering council is considered as the fulfillment of minimum quorum.
explain: A meeting is valid only when more than half (50%) of the members are present; this is the minimum quorum.

q: 2. Which type of membership is categorized in NEC Act 2055?
options: Senior divisional engineer, superintending engineer and foreign engineer
Gazzetted 1st class, Gazzetted 2nd class, Gazzetted 3rd class
explain: NEC Act 2055 classifies registered engineers as general, professional and foreign engineers. The other options are government service designations.

q: 3. Engineering profession needs cooperation with the profession of
explain: Engineering projects often require inputs from medical (safety/health), accounting (finance), and legal (contracts) professionals, so cooperation with all these professions is needed.

q: 4. In Nepal, which of the following act contains the provisions on health and safety of the workers?
explain: The Labour Act specifically outlines statutory regulations concerning occupational health, safety measures, and workplace environments for workers.

q: 5. Which type of membership is not categorized in NEC act 2055?
explain: Senior divisional, superintending and chief engineer are civil service posts, not NEC membership categories, so all of them are not categorized.

q: 6. The total number of members in Nepal engineering council is
explain: As per the Nepal Engineering Council Act, 2055, the Council is constituted with a total of 18 members.

q: 7. The tenure of registrar of Nepal engineering council is ........
explain: The book's answer key gives 4 years. Note that Q66 asks the same thing and the key gives 2 years there, so the book is inconsistent; verify against the NEC Act.

q: 8. According to Labour Act, maximum working hour for a labour per week should be
explain: The Nepal Labour Act sets the maximum weekly working hours for a labourer at 48 hours.

q: 9. The number of members in NEC are ........
explain: As per the answer key, the council has 21 members.

q: 10. Workers are not allowed to work continuously more than
explain: As per the Labour Act, a worker must be given a break after continuous work of 5 hours.

q: 11. The minimum qualification required for professional engineer is ........
explain: The answer key gives master in engineering. Qualification rules have been amended over time, so verify against the current NEC regulation.

q: 12. The minimum qualification required for foreign engineer is ........
options: bachelor in engineering and 5 years experience
bachelor in engineering and 10 years experience
master in engineering and 5 years experience
master in engineering and 5 years experience
explain: As per the answer key, a foreign engineer needs a bachelor's degree plus 10 years of experience. Options c and d are identical in the book.

q: 13. Nepal Engineering Council regulation, 2057 is effective from
explain: The Nepal Engineering Council Regulation, 2057, came into effect on 2057/3/8 B.S., as per NEC records.

q: 14. For the registration of general engineer the amount of fee required is
explain: The registration fee prescribed for a General Engineer under NEC rules is NRs 1,500 (later revised upward to NRs 3,000).

q: 15. The Nepal Engineers' Association was established in
explain: Nepal Engineers' Association (NEA) was established in the year 2024 BS (1968 AD) as a professional body of engineers in Nepal.

q: 16. The minimum qualification required for a general engineer is
explain: A General Engineer must hold at least a Bachelor's degree in engineering for registration with NEC.

q: 17. The number of members in Nepal Engineers' Association are
explain: The executive committee representation structure historically defines core office bearers/members standard groupings in the association setup.

q: 18. The minimum qualification required for a professional engineer is
explain: Registration as a Professional Engineer requires a Master's degree in engineering along with the required experience.

q: 19. नेपाल इन्जिनियरिङ परिषद् ऐन, २०५५ लालमोहर र प्रकाशन मिति कुन हो ?
explain: The Nepal Engineering Council Act, 2055 received royal assent and formal publication on 2055/11/27 BS.

q: 20. The minimum qualification & experience required for the registration of foreigner engineers is
options: bachelor in engineering and 5 years' experience
bachelor in engineering and 10 yrs experience
master in engineering and 5 yrs experience
master in engineering and 10 yrs experience
explain: Foreign engineers must have a Bachelor's degree in engineering with a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience to register in Nepal.

q: 21. नेपाल इन्जिनियरिङ परिष‌द्मा कति जना सदस्य हुन्छन ?
explain: According to the Nepal Engineering Council Act 2055, the executive council is composed of 18 total members including the Chairman and Vice-Chairman.

q: 22. NEC मा NEA मध्ये निर्वाचन गरी पठाएको सदस्यहरुको संख्या कति हुन्छ?
explain: Nepal Engineers' Association (NEA) elects and sends 5 representative members to the Nepal Engineering Council (NEC).

q: 23. NEC मा मनोनित वा निवार्चित सदस्यको पदावधि कति दिनको हुन्छ ?
explain: As per the provisions of the NEC Act, the tenure of nominated or elected members of the Council is 4 years.

q: 24. NEC regulation 2057, is effective from ........
explain: As per the answer key, the regulation came into effect on 2057/03/08 BS.

q: 25. NEC को बैठकमा कति प्रतिशत भन्दा बढी सदस्यको संख्या उपस्थिपत भएमा परिषद्‌को बैठकको लागि गणपूरक संख्या पुगेको मानिन्छ ?
explain: A simple majority of more than 50% of total sitting members is required to meet the legal quorum for holding NEC council meetings.

q: 26. The number of members in NEA are ........
explain: As per the answer key, the answer is 25.

q: 27. नेपाल इन्जिनियरिङ परिषद् ऐन, २०५५ मा कतिवटा दफा रहेछन् ?
explain: The primary legislation of the Nepal Engineering Council Act, 2055 consists of a total of 38 sections (दफा).

q: 28. NEA was established in ........
explain: The Nepal Engineers' Association was established in 1962 AD, per the answer key.

q: 29. NEC अन्तर्गत कतिवटा नेपाल इन्जिनियरिङ व्यवसायलाई संलग्न गरिएको छ?
explain: There are 25 recognized main streams/disciplines classified under the technical engineering practice framework in NEC rules.

q: 30. NEC was established in ........ BS.
explain: NEC was established under the Nepal Engineering Council Act 2055 BS.

q: 31. नेपाल इन्जिनियरिङ परिषद्‌को अध्यक्ष पदको लागी न्युन्तम योग्यता कति निर्धारण गरिएको छ?
explain: The minimum educational requirement for appointment as Chairman of the Nepal Engineering Council is a Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (along with experience qualifications).

q: 32. नेपाल इन्जिनियरिङ परिषदले श्री ५ को सरकारसँग सम्पर्क राख्दा कुन मंत्रालय मार्फत सम्पर्क राख्नु पर्ने छ ?
explain: The parent line ministry representing the Nepal Engineering Council to the Government is the Ministry of Physical Infrastructure and Transport.

q: 33. नेपाल इन्जिनियरिङ परिषद् नियमालवी, २०५७ सम्बन्धी कुन गलत छ ?
options: ने.ई.प.नि, २०५७ को निर्माण NEC ले गरेको हो ।
ने.ई.प.नि, २०५७ को निर्माण NEC ले NEC Act 2055 को दफा ३७ बमोजिम गरेको हो ।
explain: Both statements (a) and (b) correctly reflect how NEC Regulation 2057 was framed under Section 37 authority, making none of the options incorrect.

q: 34. NEC ले इन्जिनियरहरुलाई कति भागमा बिभाजन गरेका छन् ?
explain: NEC categorizes registered engineers into 3 primary classifications: General Engineer, Professional Engineer, and Foreign Engineer.

q: 35. Professional code of conduct issued by Nepal Engineering Council has
explain: The Professional Code of Conduct issued by NEC is organized into 8 articles covering various aspects of professional behavior.

q: 36. As per the NEC Act, 2055 the name of engineers
explain: The legislative categorizations specified for membership registers are General Engineer, Professional Engineer, and Foreigner Engineer.

q: 37. NEC Regulation, 2057 is effective from
explain: Nepal Engineering Council Regulations 2057 came into legal force officially on 2057/03/08 BS.

q: 38. Who is the chairperson of central labour advisory board (CLAB)?
options: Director general, department of labour member
explain: The Central Labour Advisory Board (CLAB) is chaired by the Labour Minister (or State Minister for Labour) as per the Labour Act.

q: 39. The number of countries in which Nepal Engineering Council has recognized the academic institutions are (September, 2013)
explain: According to NEC records up to September 2013, engineering academic institutions across 40 countries were formally recognized for engineering registration.

q: 40. As per Nepal Engineering Council Act 2055, the tenure of the members of the council is
explain: The NEC Act 2055 prescribes a tenure of 4 years for the members of the Council.

q: 41. The Engineering Council members consist of the following members
explain: The governing board/council of the Nepal Engineering Council is comprised of 18 executive members.

q: 42. Which of the following category of engineer is not mentioned in engineering council rule, 2057 for registration?
explain: The rule recognizes general, professional and foreign (non-Nepali) engineers. Chartered engineer is not a registration category.

q: 43. Which one type of membership is not categorized by NEC?
explain: Superintendent Engineer is a promotional departmental designation in civil services rather than a registration category under NEC Act.

q: 44. For the registration of general engineer the amount of fee required is
explain: As specified under the NEC Regulations schedule of fees, the standard application fee for a General Engineer registration is NRs 3000.

q: 45. For the registiration of professinal engineers the amount of fee required is
explain: The official fee for registration under the Professional Engineer category is set at NRs 10,000.

q: 46. For the registration of foreginer engineers the amount of fee required is
explain: Foreign engineers registering to practice in Nepal under Category C/Foreign Engineer are charged NRs 15,000.

q: 47. The registered engineers in Nepal engineering council should have to renew their registration in ........
explain: The answer key gives 'none of these', meaning the renewal interval is not one of the listed periods.

q: 48. If the registration of an engineers is cancealed from NEC his name will be registerered or not if engineer is ready to register his name (दफा)-18 NEC, regulution
explain: Under Section 18 of NEC Regulation, re-registration/restoration is permissible subject to meeting council conditions and approval.

q: 49. In general, Nepal engineering council meeting per year should be held ........
explain: As per the answer key, the council meets four times a year.

q: 50. The minimum qulification required for a general engineer is
explain: To register as a General Engineer with NEC, the baseline academic qualification is a Bachelor's degree in Engineering (B.E. / B.Tech).
